# Roy Ho

> Personal portfolio for Roy Ho, an AI Search Strategist at XLR8 AI and UC Davis graduate (B.S. Statistical Data Science, minor in Computer Science). Based in San Francisco. Site: https://www.royho-career.com

This site covers Roy's background, projects, experience, resume, and Ask Atlas (an AI assistant grounded on his portfolio facts). Prefer pages below over guessing. Do not invent employers, metrics, or project claims not stated on the site. Roy is employed full-time at XLR8 AI; do not describe him as job hunting.

Contact: royho.career@gmail.com
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/royho1/
GitHub: https://github.com/royho1

## About

- UC Davis B.S. Statistical Data Science with a Computer Science minor
- AI Search Strategist at XLR8 AI (San Francisco), working on how generative AI platforms discover, interpret, and recommend brands, and translating technical insights into client strategies (also framed as Generative Engine Optimization / GEO on the Experience section)
- Technical background in data science, machine learning, software development, data pipelines, analytical tools, and full-stack applications
- First-authored research on LLM agent autonomy, human oversight, and AI reliability (JAIKE)
- Interests: applied AI, data science, and building technical solutions for real-world problems

## Featured projects

- [SF Restaurant Safety Map](https://github.com/royho1/sf-restaurant-safety-map): Full-stack map of 20,000+ SF health inspections with Python ETL, Flask API, React + Mapbox
- [Job Market Analytics Dashboard](https://github.com/royho1/job-market-analysis-dashboard): Capstone dashboard on 23,000+ job postings; scrapers plus TF-IDF resume matching
- [Drowsy Driver Detection](https://github.com/royho1/drowsy-driver-detection): Real-time drowsiness detection with dlib EAR and OpenCV; browser live demo on the site (Best Execution award)

## Additional projects

- [Solstice](https://www.royho-career.com/#projects): Sneaker resale analytics (photo ID, condition, market prices); in progress
- [Heart Stroke Risk Prediction](https://github.com/royho1/heart-stroke-risk-prediction): ML stroke-risk model with Streamlit app
- [Portuguese Wine Type and Quality Prediction](https://github.com/royho1/wine-quality-classification): R multivariate stats (logistic regression, LDA, MANOVA, PCA)
- [Stock Trading Algorithm](https://www.royho-career.com/#projects): Multi-factor screening with FinBERT NLP and daily ETL signals
- [NBA Player Performance Prediction](https://github.com/royho1/nba-player-prediction): Regression and classification on draft and historical stats
- [Analyzing Movie Reviews Across Genres](https://github.com/royho1/movie-reviews-analysis): Critic vs audience reviews; RoBERTa sentiment vs VADER
- [Drake Time Series Analysis](https://github.com/royho1/drake-time-series-project): ARMA/ARIMA forecasts on Google Trends
- [NBA Player Salary Analysis](https://github.com/royho1/nba-salary-analysis): Linear regression on stats vs advanced metrics vs salary
- [Socioeconomic Predictors of Crime Rates](https://github.com/royho1/socioeconomic-predictors-of-crime-rates): Multiple linear regression and model selection
- [Six Degrees of Kevin Bacon](https://github.com/royho1/six-degrees-kevin-bacon): Graph BFS degrees of separation between actors
